minimum: Explain the improvement of the underemployed e7 knight through g8/f6 and its central/kingside options; a route or restored d5 guard alone is insufficient.
Explain why the c4 knight and its current duties can remain while the other knight improves; retain consequential support loss and replacement guard.
Show actual reply-conditioned preservation or alteration of the improving function, with actual piece/path witnesses. Do not claim the root score cause or forced bestness.

minimum: Explain Ne7 as the start of regrouping to challenge or exchange the e4 knight, rather than retreat, a pawn push or rook entry.
Link the longer preparation to Black keeping f-file pressure; accept another actual route that serves that task without asserting the book line is forced.
Compare actual replies under which the e4 task is continued, changes realization, or becomes unnecessary when the target moves; keep target identity distinct from a fixed square.

completion: Both preregistered purposes and reply differences must reach actual basic screens within fresh ten-second jobs; no case expansion or completion from tests alone.
development_findings: Baseline Ng8 repeated the historical route/guard-only failure; baseline Ne7 explained a transposition rather than the purpose of regrouping.
Reading a longer route only from returned PVs still lost Ne7 whenever the shallow root line changed. A bounded geometric knight route must be a distinct conditional plan, not an observed line.
A possible plan, observed pressure, a relocated target, and an unfinished plan must remain different states. Functional identity follows original targets and pressure, not destination equality.
The original target must remain continuously on its post; leaving and returning to e4 cannot revive the old task.
Queen pressure on e4 does not have the mutual legal knight-capture affordance of the planned knight exchange.
A retained companion must be checked after selected captures and immediate recaptures, not before the recapture.
Cold first requests repeatedly exceeded ten seconds before the final changes; complete answers constructed after the deadline did not count as delivered.

Profiling found repeated full-PV interpretation, occurrence assembly, and terminal publication costs. A selected-purpose answer still inherited all candidate position_ids, making the optional catalogue defeat delivery pruning.

Short jobs now use two root candidates, read the current purpose replies first, and initially compare the root-PV reply against its opposing function class. This is a restricted contrast, not a claim of global best defense.
novelty_check: Older Janowski name hits were Janowski–Capablanca, Havana 1913. The selected Janowski–Rubinstein 1907 position and exact FEN were not found among the prior research cases.

limits_remaining: Conditional geometric discovery is bounded to a two-hop knight regrouping; observed quiet redeployments of other non-pawn/non-king pieces can be read from existing paths.
Only one functional question is prioritized in a short job. Arbitrary long strategic plans and full strategic equivalence are not solved.
Conditional plans are neither legal multi-move forecasts nor proof of bestness or the whole root evaluation.
The fresh position was used during development; it is not a held-out performance or generalization benchmark.
Final times are measurements on this machine, not an all-position/all-load ten-second guarantee.
